scope: Personally viewed all16cited actual source panels before current keyed objects; review concerns and intended repair directions were previously known, so this is not represented as fresh blind exposure.

answers.reasoning: The actual source names KSS as the software environment, cable communication and power, and external axes/sensors as options.
The printed data-management group includes frames and calibration, whereas program management includes creating/editing/archiving programs.
Subtracting identical contact-pose equations makes every rotation difference zero, so repeated samples add no independent constraints on the TCP offset.
The printed tool number is selected before four contacts; the final linear-motion deviation check is separate verification, not proof of full orientation or error-free calibration.
The video-frame Speed4x presentation label supplies no physical velocity unit or controller override evidence.
Only fingertips directly contact the object; changing body, air ports or flange attachment violates the supplied retained-component conditions.
Equal travel does not force equal contact reactions: actuator area, pressure, compliance and loading can change forces independently of jaw parallelism.
Varied target poses constrain a fixed intrinsic camera model, but board-to-camera pose is not automatically camera-to-robot pose.
The photograph explicitly assigns object classes to bins, regardless of the bins visible hue or detected order.
Metric pose needs the calibrated projection model and known physical marker corner geometry in addition to ordered detected image corners; ID alone gives no metric scale.
The source pipeline shows rotation/translation estimation immediately after corner and ID detection.
Staging a complete immutable pose, atomically publishing its identifier and waiting for acknowledgement prevents mixed-generation fields under the stated record-lifetime model.
Left-multiply both sides by the inverse of the common leftmost world transform; right cancellation or full homogeneous transpose is generally invalid.
The actual still shows upright cyan/magenta objects on white supports, separate forward bins, empty gripper above work area and marker boards near the robot base.
